claim: How to download any video from Blackboard collaborate
summary: The bbcollab video player is a bit janky and doesn't have any speed controls, so here's a small tip for anyone wanting to download recorded lectures for use in a native player: First, click on the little ellipsis button of the recording to see if there's a download option ready to go. Instructors have to explicitly enable this option for each recording for some reason, so it might not be there ...
